newsitem.title: UK: BFI up six as Atlantic Panamaxes firm.
newsitem.headline: BFI up six as Atlantic Panamaxes firm.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index was up six on Friday at 1,367 points.
Brokers reported firmer conditions especially for modern Panamaxes in the Atlantic and to a lesser extent in the Far East.
Fresh grain enquiry from the USGulf and South America has been quoted for February and early March positions today, they said.
Caper and Handy size rates have so far shown little improvement but some brokers are optimistic that February will see an improving market for them.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was between 45 and five points uo on shortcovering prompted by the better tone in the underlying market. Turnover was 153 lots.
